description: Kalmunai Municipal Council - Notice Pertaining to the Amendments fro the Levy for Solid Waste Disposal Management Service Provided within the Limits of Kalmunai Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves amendments to municipal regulations and tax levies for solid waste disposal services. It references specific sections of the Municipal Councils Ordinance (sections 247 B (4) and 267) and provides corrections to previous gazette notifications. The content focuses on regulatory framework changes and compliance requirements for local government services, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure or other specialized categories.
